svg.title: Riju and Babul-da watch the Mission convoy stop behind the billboard.
svg.desc: Riju turns in alarm while Babul-da rests calmly beside his cycle van. Beyond the improvised traffic loop, the sleek Mission convoy has arrived but cannot pass the billboard erected for its welcome.
svg.text: Page 1, panel 5 · Street-level long shot towards the far end of the blocked lane
